bio.text: Greg Steube represents Florida's 17th Congressional District in the U.S. House, where his office says he is in a fourth term, and serves on the Ways and Means and Intelligence committees.
Before Congress he served six years in the Florida House and two years in the Florida Senate.
He earned undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Florida, served in the U.S. Army and Army JAG Corps, including a 2006-2007 deployment to Iraq, and lives in Sarasota.
